name: TCS
about: One of India's largest IT services companies, hires freshers in bulk every year through campus and off-campus drives (TCS NQT).
requirements: No active backlogs at the time of hiring
Basic programming in any one language
Good communication for the HR round

stages.name: Online Assessment
stages.what_tested: Numerical ability, verbal ability, reasoning, and basic coding (NQT pattern).
stages.tips: Practice aptitude daily for 2-3 weeks; attempt previous years' NQT papers.

stages.name: Technical Interview
stages.what_tested: Core CS subjects (OOP, DBMS, OS), your projects, and basic coding.
stages.tips: Be ready to explain every project line by line; revise CS fundamentals.

stages.name: HR
stages.what_tested: Communication, willingness to relocate, career goals.
stages.tips: Be honest and clear about your goals; keep answers structured.

name: Infosys
about: Global IT services company; the InfyTQ / campus drive is a common fresher entry point.

stages.name: Online Assessment
stages.what_tested: Quant, logical reasoning, verbal, pseudocode.
stages.tips: Focus on pseudocode-style questions, not just raw coding.

stages.name: Technical + HR Interview
stages.what_tested: Fundamentals, a coding problem, and behavioral questions, often combined into one round.
stages.tips: Prepare a short, confident project walkthrough.

name: Wipro
about: IT services company; hires freshers through WILP/Elite NLTH drives.

stages.name: Online Assessment
stages.what_tested: Aptitude, verbal, and coding (1-2 problems).
stages.tips: Practice basic DSA problems: arrays, strings, loops.

stages.name: Technical Interview
stages.what_tested: Programming basics, CS fundamentals, resume projects.
stages.tips: Know time complexity of the code you write.

stages.name: HR
stages.what_tested: Communication and culture fit.
stages.tips: Research the company's values briefly before the round.

name: Google
about: Global product company; fresher hiring (STEP/new grad) is highly selective and DSA-heavy.

stages.name: Online Assessment
stages.what_tested: 2-3 DSA coding problems, medium to hard difficulty.
stages.tips: Practice 150+ problems on arrays, trees, graphs, DP before applying.

stages.name: Technical Interviews (2-4 rounds)
stages.what_tested: DSA problem solving on a shared doc/whiteboard, and how you communicate your approach.
stages.tips: Think out loud, discuss complexity, and test your code with an example.

stages.name: Hiring Committee / HR
stages.what_tested: Overall profile review and googleyness/leadership questions.
stages.tips: Have specific stories ready (STAR format) for behavioral questions.

name: Amazon
about: E-commerce and cloud (AWS) company; fresher SDE hiring is DSA-heavy and leadership-principle driven.

stages.name: Online Assessment
stages.what_tested: 2 coding problems plus a work-style/behavioral assessment.
stages.tips: Solve within the time limit; practice on a timer.

stages.name: Technical Interviews
stages.what_tested: DSA coding plus 1 leadership-principle behavioral question per round.
stages.tips: Prepare 6-8 STAR stories mapped to different leadership principles.

stages.name: Bar Raiser
stages.what_tested: A tougher, holistic round to maintain hiring quality.
stages.tips: Stay calm, be honest about trade-offs in your answers.

name: Zoho
about: Bootstrapped Indian product company known for a strong, practical fresher hiring process.
requirements: Strong logic building over rote DSA
Willingness to go through a multi-day process

stages.name: Written Aptitude + Coding
stages.what_tested: Logic-heavy aptitude and 2 coding problems in C/Java/Python.
stages.tips: Practice logic-building puzzles, not just standard DSA patterns.

stages.name: Technical Interviews
stages.what_tested: In-depth CS fundamentals and live coding.
stages.tips: Be very clear on basics: pointers, OOP, DBMS normalization.

stages.name: HR
stages.what_tested: Fit and communication.
stages.tips: Be genuine about why you'd like a product company.

name: Generic Startup
about: A representative early-stage tech startup profile: small team, fast hiring, practical skills over pedigree.
requirements: A demo-able project or GitHub profile

stages.name: Resume + GitHub Screening
stages.what_tested: Real projects over CGPA.
stages.tips: Keep 2-3 polished, deployed projects with clean READMEs.

stages.name: Take-home Assignment
stages.what_tested: Practical ability to build a small feature end-to-end.
stages.tips: Prioritize working code and clear documentation over completeness.

stages.name: Founder/Team Interview
stages.what_tested: Culture fit, ownership mindset, communication.
stages.tips: Ask questions back; show genuine curiosity about the product.
